Class CellFilter

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tfx.CellFilter
public abstract class CellFilter extends Object
A filter that enables effects to operate on specific cells based on various criteria.

CellFilter provides a flexible, composable way to select cells for applying effects. Filters can match cells based on their properties (colors, position, content) or custom predicates, and can be combined using logical operations (AND, OR, NOR).

Design Philosophy:

  • Composability: Simple filters can be combined to create complex selection patterns using allOf, anyOf, and noneOf.
  • Performance: Filters are evaluated during cell iteration, allowing effects to skip irrelevant cells efficiently.
  • Flexibility: Supports both spatial (area, margin) and content-based (color, text) filtering.

Filter Types:

  • Spatial: area, inner, outer
  • Color: fgColor, bgColor
  • Content: text
  • Logical: allOf, anyOf, noneOf
  • Special: all, none

Usage Pattern: 

// Simple filter
Effect effect = Fx.dissolve(2000, Interpolation.Linear)
    .withFilter(CellFilter.text());

// Combined filters
CellFilter combined = CellFilter.allOf(
    CellFilter.text(),
    CellFilter.fgColor(Color.WHITE),
    CellFilter.outer(Margin.uniform(1))
);
Effect filtered = Fx.fadeToFg(Color.CYAN, 2000, Interpolation.SineInOut)
    .withFilter(combined);

Filters are evaluated during effect execution, allowing effects to efficiently skip cells that don't match the filter criteria.

    • matches

      public boolean matches(int x, int y, Cell cell, Rect area)
      Checks if a cell matches this filter using primitive coordinates.

      This overload avoids Position object allocation in performance-critical loops. The default implementation creates a Position and delegates to matches(Position, Cell, Rect). Subclasses that can work with primitive coordinates directly should override this method.

      Parameters:
      x - The cell's x coordinate
      y - The cell's y coordinate
      cell - The cell to check
      area - The area being processed
      Returns:
      true if the cell matches the filter
